title: Azure CLI and Developer Tooling
description: Install the Azure CLI, learn essential commands, install extensions, and control output formats for automation.

data.text: The **Azure CLI** is a cross-platform command-line tool for managing Azure resources. It works on Windows, macOS, and Linux. Every command starts with `az`, followed by a group like `group` or `vm`, then a command like `create` or `list`.
Install the Azure CLI using your operating system's package manager or the official installer. After installation, open a terminal and run `az version` to confirm it is installed correctly.

data.title: Common Azure CLI Commands
data.code:
# Log in interactively
az login

# Log in with a service principal for automation
az login --service-principal -u <appId> -p <password-or-cert> --tenant <tenant>

# Set your default subscription
az account set --subscription "MySubscriptionNameOrId"

# List all subscriptions
az account list --output table

# List resource groups
az group list --output table

# Create a resource group
az group create --name MyResourceGroup --location eastus

# Create a storage account
az storage account create \
  --name mystorageaccount12345 \
  --resource-group MyResourceGroup \
  --location eastus \
  --sku Standard_LRS \
  --kind StorageV2

# Get details about a resource group
az group show --name MyResourceGroup

data.text: Azure CLI extensions add extra commands that are not included in the core installation. For example, `azure-cli-ml` adds machine learning commands. You can browse available extensions with `az extension list-available --output table`.

data.title: Managing Extensions
data.code:
# List available extensions
az extension list-available --output table

# Install an extension
az extension add --name azure-devops

# Update all installed extensions
az extension update --all

# Remove an extension
az extension remove --name azure-devops

data.text: By default, the Azure CLI returns JSON. For scripts and automation, you can change the output format to `json`, `yaml`, `table`, `tsv`, or `jsonc`. Use `--output` (or `-o`) on any command.

rows: Columns and rows in the terminal

data.title: Pro Tip
data.text: Set your default output format once with `az config set core.output=jsonc` so you never have to type `--output` again.

terms.definition: A cross-platform command-line tool for managing Azure resources using `az` commands.
An add-on for the Azure CLI that provides additional commands for specific services.
The format in which the Azure CLI returns data, such as JSON, table, or TSV.
